subject: Legacy tenant onboarding audit — training certs & deprovision trail
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@everwellhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for legacy tenant

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. We’re running a SIG/CAIQ deep-dive for one of our regulators and need a narrow set of artifacts for the legacy tenant you host on our account. Specifically we’re asking for:

- Staff training completion records (security awareness + data handling) for contractors and employees who had access to the tenant (2019–2026)
- Redacted background check confirmations or attestation that checks were completed
- Deprovisioning / access revocation logs when people left or changed roles
- Any documented onboarding/offboarding playbook or checklist used during that period

If you can bundle the items or point us to a drive link, that’d be ideal. We’re targeting submission by end of next week (2027-04-30). If scope clarification would help, happy to hop on a quick call — Sam Taylor (Compliance), Everwell Health.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Taylor
Senior Compliance Manager
Everwell Health
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@everwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for legacy tenant

Sam —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble all of these artifacts. A couple of quick clarifying questions to scope the pull:

- When you say "legacy tenant", can you confirm the tenant ID or account alias (we have a few historical tenants in our older infra)?
- Do you need original background check PDFs or are redacted attestations sufficient? We usually provide redacted PDFs plus an HR attestation letter for SIG/CAIQ.
- Is the date range strictly 2019–2026 or should we include early 2018 onboarding records tied to migrations?

I’ll coordinate with HR and security to collect the training matrix, redacted BG checks, and the deprovisioning CSV export. I’ll also include a short narrative that maps each artifact to SIG/CAIQ control IDs.

I’ve looped in Kimberly (HR), Marissa (Security Ops), and Soojin (Legal ops) to pull records and confirm redaction scope. Expect a follow-up with a shared Drive link by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for legacy tenant

Kimberly / Marissa —

Per Sam’s request below, we need to assemble a SIG/CAIQ-focused packet for Everwell Health. Please treat this as an evidence pull with redaction constraints (PII removed; employee IDs hashed). Deadline is 2027-04-30 but let’s try to have a first pass to me by EOD Thursday (2027-04-22) so I can review before sending.

Ask list (deliverables):
- training-completion-matrix-2019-2026.csv (columns: name, email, role, course, completion_date, cert_id, course_version) — Marissa, can you export from LMS?
- redacted-bg-checks.zip — Kimberly, HR can produce redacted scans and a one-paragraph attestation confirming scope and vendor used
- deprovision-access-log-legacy-tenant.csv — Marissa, export of IAM revocation events for tenant IDs matching "legacy-*" (include timestamp, principal, action, revoked_by)
- onboarding-offboarding-playbook.pdf — consolidated checklist that was used historically (2018–2021) if available

Notes on redaction: remove DOBs and SSNs; keep hire/exit month and year; replace employee IDs with hashed tokens (sha256 partial ok). Legal (Soojin) please confirm the redaction rule set — use minimal data necessary.

I’ll compile the Drive folder and produce a short mapping doc (artifact -> SIG control).

Thanks all,
Jonas
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for legacy tenant

Jonas —

We can get the HR side done. Quick status: 

- redacted-bg-checks-everwell.zip (stub) — HR will provide redacted proofs for contractors and employees tied to the legacy tenant. We will remove PII per Soojin’s guidance; redaction log included.
- For historical hires (2018–2019) some vendor receipts are archived; I’ll include attestation for vendor used and sampling methodology (we can’t pull every legacy PDF without additional approvals).
- Onboarding playbook — I found an older checklist (onboarding-playbook-2019.pdf) and will include it if there are no objections.

I’ll upload the artifacts to a restricted Drive folder and send the link to you and Sam. Expect the upload by 2027-04-23 noon PT. If Everwell needs unredacted originals, we’ll need a DPA amendment and a signed NDA; assumed redacted attestation is acceptable.

Kimberly Park
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@everwellhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverable: Everwell legacy-tenant personnel & deprovision packet

Sam —

Thanks for your patience. I’ve uploaded the evidence bundle to a restricted folder and attached a short mapping document that ties each artifact to SIG/CAIQ control statements. Summary of contents (attached / in folder):

- training-completion-matrix-2019-2026.csv (export from LMS; includes hashed employee IDs and completion dates)
- deprovision-access-log-legacy-tenant.csv (IAM revocations CSV; columns: timestamp, principal_hash, action, revoked_by)
- redacted-bg-checks-everwell.zip (redacted vendor reports + HR attestation.pdf)
- onboarding-playbook-2019.pdf (historical checklist)
- artifact-to-control-mapping.docx (narrative mapping to SIG control IDs)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeXyzEverwellOnboardAudit
Reference: HUBSPOT-REC-548213

A few caveats and notes:
- For privacy we redacted DOB and SSN equivalents and replaced employee IDs with hashed tokens. The redaction log is included in the zip.
- For hires prior to 2019 some original vendor receipts are archived off-platform; we included HR attestations describing the sampling and retention policy.
- If Everwell requires unredacted originals for a regulator, please send the DPA amendment and we’ll coordinate a secure transfer path.

If anything in the packet is insufficient or you want a control-level walkthrough, I can schedule a 30-minute call next week.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted-bg-checks-everwell.zip (archive), training-completion-matrix-2019-2026.csv (spreadsheet), deprovision-access-log-legacy-tenant.csv (csv), artifact-to-control-mapping.docx (docx)
